landing.heroTitle: Learn to sell by talking to an AI customer
landing.heroSub: Pick your profession, call a realistic AI customer, handle objections and close the deal. Get scored instantly and level up.
landing.step1Text: Pick a profession and a scenario: friendly, busy, skeptical… or describe your own product.
landing.step2Text: Talk out loud in Georgian or English. The AI stays in character and only buys if you earn it.
landing.step3Text: See scores for 6 skills, what you did well, what to improve, and a better version of your weakest line.
landing.pricingSub: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready to go pro.
landing.t1: I practised my investor pitch ten times before the real meeting. It worked.
landing.t2: The skeptical customer is tougher than my real clients — in a good way.
landing.t3: Finally I'm not afraid of the word 'expensive'.
landing.a1: For voice calls, yes. You can also practice in text-chat mode.
landing.a2: Georgian and English — for the site and for the AI customer.
landing.a3: Yes. The free plan includes free courses and 3 AI calls per day.
landing.q4: Can I practise selling my own product?
landing.a4: Yes. Choose "My own product", describe it, and the AI becomes your typical customer.

legal.privacyBody: We store your account details (name, email, avatar from Google), your learning progress, call transcripts and scores so the service can work. Payment data is handled by Flitt; we never see your card number. Voice audio is processed by Google Gemini in real time and is not recorded by us unless you agree. You can export or delete your data at any time from your profile.
legal.termsBody: PitchUp is a training tool. AI feedback is guidance, not a guarantee of results. Don't use the service for unlawful or abusive content. Pro is prepaid for one month or one year and does not renew automatically. One-time course purchases give lifetime access to that course.
